episodeTitle.zh: 关于SAFe和产品负责人的角色，你想知道的一切 | 梅利莎·佩里

guestBioOfficial.en: Melissa Perri is the founder of Product Institute, author of Escaping the Build Trap, and host of the Product Thinking Podcast. She has worked with startups, Fortune 50 companies, and everything in between to help them build better products and level up their product teams. In our conversation, we discuss: • The history of the product owner role
guestBioOfficial.zh:
梅利莎·佩里（Melissa Perri）是Product Institute的创始人，《摆脱构建陷阱》（Escaping the Build Trap）一书的作者，以及Product Thinking播客的主持人。她曾与初创企业、财富50强公司及介于两者之间的各类企业合作，助力它们打造更优质的产品，并提升产品团队的专业水平。在我们的对谈中，我们探讨了以下内容：  
• 产品负责人的角色发展历程

summary.en: In this episode, Melissa shares practical perspectives on product management and building effective teams. She discusses how strong product culture and clear priorities help organizations move faster. The conversation offers actionable takeaways for product leaders navigating growth and execution.
summary.zh: 在本期节目中，梅丽莎分享了关于产品管理与打造高效团队的务实观点。她探讨了强大的产品文化与清晰优先级如何让组织跑得更快。本期为在产品增长与执行中探索的领导者提供了可落地的要点。
